scope: CPU model/texture and sampled-pose review; not full motion or engine acceptance
visual_verdict: Suitable initial third-person engine draft. Hold crew expansion/final hero acceptance until native appearance and continuous motion are reviewed.
improvements: Recognizable curly-haired bearded adult, mature proportions and original wardrobe identity.
Integrated teal cargo trousers/pockets, clean continuous cuffs, detailed high-top canvas shoes.
Side hand views show five separated digits on each hand.
Sampled Idle/Walk/Run deform without gross exploding vertices, detached clothing or obvious major tears.
visible_defects: Hands remain coarse and faceted at knuckles/tips; right hand has a planar crease/seam, whole-hand rig lacks individual finger controls.
Face looks smoother and paler than the reference under this studio setup; native lighting/material still needs review.
Jagged pale collar/neck rim and thick shiny rope-like curls are visible in close crops.
Armpit/crotch/knee folds pinch sharply during sampled motion; no cloth simulation.
limits: Static views cannot establish fluid motion, planted feet, transition quality or runtime performance.
Fixed neutral floor: sampled lowest shoe vertices are approximately -1.1cm Idle, +3.4cm Walk, +4.5cm Run; flight/contact correctness needs continuous/native review.
Raw UV/normal-split boundary counts are not hole counts. Disposable 1-micrometre position-weld metric still has48boundary and91non-manifold edges; no watertightness claim or geometry repair.
These are supplied PBR textures in Cycles, not the final comic-book engine shading.
